reasonChirho: Empty, empty-handed, foolish/senseless, physically vacant, worthless persons, formlessness, primordial chaos, void, nothingness — value assessment (worthlessness) and features.
Well-pleasing, acceptable, smoothness, flattery, slippery, soothing, pleasant, delightful, be sweet — attitudes/emotions and sensory evaluation.
Touch physically for healing, touch to harm, prohibited contact, reach/arrive/extend, be stricken — attachment (contact) and physical impact.
Worker, laborer, labor, toil, hard work, trouble, annoyance, product of labor, gain, misery — performing work and hardship.
Seed, wheat, grain, food supply, cereal crop, fresh grain, unripe ear — plants (cereal grains) and food.
Desolation, waste, devastation, horror, appalment, become desolate, laid waste, state of ruin — destruction and resulting physical state.
Inheritance, allotted heritage, take possession of land, possession, landed property, covenant portion — possession/transfer and geographical territory.
Draw, drag physically, draw/attract spiritually, be prolonged/deferred, pull out, extend, wield weapon — linear movement of pulling and extension.
Be alive, have life, come back to life, conduct one's life, keep alive, preserve alive, spare, recover from illness, revive — physiological state of life and existence.
Remind active, remember/recall, be remembered, called to mind, call to remembrance — memory and recall.
White, white color adjective — features of objects (color).
Night, lodge overnight, remain overnight, dwell, abide, spend the night, period of darkness — time (nighttime) and spatial existence.
Linen fabric material, fine linen/byssus, flax — activities involving cloth and artifacts.
Fat, well-fed, fatling, fattened animal, fertile land, rich/sumptuous food — features of objects (quality/condition) and food.
Peace, well-being, harmony, absence of conflict, greeting of peace, friend, ally, make peace, peace offering — relief/wellbeing and reconciliation.
Once, cardinal number one, distributive each, the other one, eleven — number domain.
Unnecessary, superfluous, advantage, superiority, be greedy, covet, profit, gain, unjust gain, covetousness — attitudes of greed and possession.
Unrighteousness, injustice, lawlessness, iniquity, wickedness, Aven place name, Beth Aven — moral/ethical violations plus place names.
Answer, respond verbally, reply, testify, bear witness, be answered, respond antiphonally — verbal communication and legal testimony.
Perfect, complete, mature, whole, blameless, upright, quiet, mild, simple, flawless — moral/ethical quality and genuineness.
Greed, covetousness, plunder, spoil, prey, booty, robbery — possession (forcible transfer) and violence.
Rod, staff, scepter, poles, staves, divination rod, walking stick, spindle — artifacts of authority and utility.
Trembling, fearful, fear, anxiety — attitudes/emotions of fear.
Wither, dry up, become parched, cause to dry up, make dry, be put to shame — physical state of drying with metaphorical shame.
Last, final, later, afterward, hereafter, latter condition, future, descendants — sequence (terminal position) and time.
Reward, wage, hire, harlot's hire, earn wages, salary, fare — possession/exchange (payment) and reward.
Boldness, confidence, openly, publicly, plainly — attitudes of courage and public communication.
Beget, father a child, give birth, bear, produce, bring forth vegetation/fruit — physiological process of reproduction and becoming.
Repay, recompense, be repaid, reward, give back, return, restore, yield fruit, sell — transfer/exchange and reward.
The letter of the Law, letter of alphabet, written document, Scriptures, epistle, learning, letter — written communication and artifacts.
Eating, eat food, consume, devour, eat/chew, feed — physiological process of eating and food.
Strip bare, uncover, expose, strip bark/peel, lay bare, tear off, strip clothing, flay/skin, rob/despoil — clothing removal and physical impact.
Why interrogative, what/which, someone/something indefinite, in/by/with what — discourse referentials and markers.
Horn, trumpet, sound a trumpet, blow, trumpet metal instrument, horn as strength/power, rays of light — artifacts (instruments) and physical events (sound/light).
Show, display, reveal, make known, indicate, be shown, inform, report, demonstrate, signify — making known and communication.
Remembrance, mention, renown, fame, memorial, commemoration, memorial token, written records, chronicles — memory/recall and communication.
Here, from here, on this side, hither — spatial position demonstratives.
Woe, alas, ho — exclamations of distress and grief, functioning as discourse/emotional markers.
Forget, neglect, be forgotten, cause to forget — memory/recall (failure thereof) and cognition.
Lion, large predatory feline, young lion, lion cub, lioness — animals (predatory), often symbolizing power.
Folly, foolishness, stupidity, senselessness, outrageous folly, disgrace — failure to understand and moral deficiency.
Find, discover, be found, be discovered, those present, deliver/hand over, reach/overtake — learning (discovery) and events.
Buy goods, purchase, redeem persons, acquire, obtain, possess, buy grain — possession/transfer/exchange.
Then, so, therefore, for which reason, inferential — discourse markers of logical inference.
Life, manner of living, livelihood, possessions, vitality, lifespan, the living, preservation — physiological life and possessions.
Still, yet, no longer, not anymore, stand still, cease, again, more, further, another — temporal continuity and affirmation/negation.
Generation, people of an era, lineage period, kind/type, family, offspring, race, nation, contemporaries, perpetuity — kinship terms and groups.
Rebel against authority, rebel substantive, provoke to anger, disobedient, defiant, transgressor — hostility/strife and refusal to follow.
Foot, leg of animal, place at the feet, foot/base, slander/go about as talebearer — body parts with metaphorical extension to gossip/movement.
Proof, evidence, proven character, tested quality, testing, ordeal, trial — learning (testing/examination) and true/false verification.
